annotations.text: 1 · ROUND SCREEN — before every fight: who fights whom, the bench shelf, the busiest enemy lineups, and a fallen unit
1.1 Face-off, round 1 — named fighters, underlined terms, tap a fighter (proposal)
1.2 Most bodies — Pack, 5 enemies (proposal)
1.3 Mini-boss, two kinds — a 💥 badge marks the slammer (proposal)
1.4 Warden — ✚ 💥 badges, full squad (proposal)
1.5 A unit fell — empty slot, Fight disabled until filled (proposal)
2 · FIGHTER POPUP — tap a fighter on 1.1 (later, mid-fight too)
2.1 Bram, the Tank — Breaking; stats, skill, switcher (proposal)
2.2 Sol, the Healer — Frayed (proposal)
2.3 Ivy, the Damage — Worn (proposal)
2.4 Warden, the enemy — 8 chips, the switcher row scrolls (what-if: 6 fielded; proposal)
2.5 Popup → Guard card, second level (proposal)
2.6 A fallen fighter — greyed, what was lost, how to bring them back (proposal; one popup for fight and round screen)
3 · TERM AND SKILL CARDS — tap an underlined word on 1.1 or a popup, or the 'See … in action' row on a skill tile; each plays a short loop
3.1 Slam (proposal)
3.2 Guard — a Tank's skill (proposal; 1.1 is a stand-in behind it)
3.3 Mend — a Healer's skill (proposal; 1.1 is a stand-in behind it)
3.4 Expose — a Damage unit's skill (proposal; 1.1 is a stand-in behind it)
3.5 Exposed (proposal)
3.6 Frozen (proposal; 1.1 is a stand-in behind it)
3.7 Burn (proposal; 1.1 is a stand-in behind it)
3.8 Shield (proposal)
3.9 Chain (proposal)
3.10 Backfire (proposal; 1.1 is a stand-in behind it)
3.11 Fatigue (proposal; 1.1 is a stand-in behind it)
4 · SQUAD SCREEN — opened from the bench shelf, Change squad ›
4.1 The bench — resting and mid-swap (proposal)
5 · FIGHT SCREEN — only what the fight needs: the key moments, with every status (proposal, not built)
5.1 Fight starts — charge bars, small shields, four fatigue faces (proposal)
5.2 A skill fires and repeats — the tag on the unit: EXPOSE ×3, stopped, the result, and every tag size (proposal)
5.3 Slam and Guard — winds up, the Guard takes it, a freeze shatters it (proposal)
5.4 Backfires — Expose, Guard and Mend each go wrong; the tag turns red (proposal)
5.5 Statuses — trouble, recovery, and every shield case (proposal)
5.6 Result — VICTORY over the finished fight (proposal)
5.7 Result — DEFEAT, the squad is wiped (proposal)
6 · REWARD PICK — after a win; a rune is one round emblem
6.1 Reward pick → next round screen — a rune is one round emblem (proposal, built)
6.2 Many runes — two newest and a +N tile; the full list explains the 9/9 rule (proposal, built)
6.3 At the cap — pick, then drop one (proposal)
7 · RUN OVER — after a lost fight
7.1 Run over — how close, best moment, build, Try again (proposal)
8 · HERO POPUPS — three units merge into one hero: its recipe, a gift that is always on, and a skill (proposal, design only, not built)
